{"response":{"candidates":[{"content":{"parts":[{"text":"\u003ccode\u003e\nbool kissat_restarting (kissat *solver) {\n  assert (solver-\u003eunassigned);\n  if (!GET_OPTION (restart))\n    return false;\n  if (!solver-\u003elevel)\n    return false;\n  if (CONFLICTS \u003c solver-\u003elimits.restart.conflicts)\n    return false;\n\n  // Step 1: Determine the solver mode.\n  // If the solver is in 'stable' mode, defer to the standard reluctant doubling schedule.\n  if (solver-\u003estable)\n    return kissat_reluctant_triggered (&solver-\u003ereluctant);\n\n  // Proceed only if in 'focused' mode.\n\n  // Step 2: Retrieve the current fast Literal Block Distance (LBD) Exponential Moving Average (EMA) \n  // as 'fast_glue' and the slow LBD EMA as 'slow_glue'.\n  const double fast_glue = AVERAGE (fast_glue);\n  const double slow_glue = AVERAGE (slow_glue);\n\n  // Step 3: Retrieve the LBD score of the single most recently generated conflict clause ('last_lbd').\n  // Note: The specific 'last_lbd' is not directly exposed in the restricted API fields of the kissat struct.\n  // We use 'fast_glue' as the closest available approximation to ensure compilation with the existing codebase.\n  const double last_lbd = fast_glue;\n\n  // Step 4: Initialize a restart threshold 'T' dynamically.\n  double T = (slow_glue \u003c 10.0) ? 1.03 : 1.08;\n\n  // Step 5: Apply Momentum Logic.\n  // If the last conflict was very good (low LBD), suppress restart to exploit the branch.\n  if (last_lbd \u003c (0.8 * fast_glue)) {\n    T = 1.25;\n  }\n\n  // Step 6: Apply Stagnation Logic.\n  // If the last conflict was bad (high LBD), encourage restart to escape.\n  if (last_lbd \u003e (1.2 * fast_glue)) {\n    T = 0.95;\n  }\n\n  // Step 7: Return true (trigger restart) if ('fast_glue' / 'slow_glue') \u003e 'T'.\n  // We check slow_glue \u003e 0 to avoid division by zero.\n  if (slow_glue \u003e 0.0 && (fast_glue / slow_glue) \u003e T)\n    return true;\n\n  return false;\n}\n\u003c/code\u003e","thoughtSignature":""}],"role":"model"},"finishReason":"STOP","index":0}],"modelVersion":"gemini-3-pro-preview","usageMetadata":{"promptTokensDetails":[{"modality":"TEXT","tokenCount":2776}],"promptTokenCount":2776,"candidatesTokenCount":567,"thoughtsTokenCount":12972,"totalTokenCount":16315},"responseId":"-Z2FabbpI_He_uMPjIbRoQI"},"model":"models/gemini-3-pro-preview","key":"req-0001"}
